actions.label: Opens the agent's terminal at its dialog
The PR (for Merge: merging is done there, by you)
Dismiss this occurrence of the item
Park the item or the work item
Put a ball and a text on the row
Take back a pass, or clear your gesture
Send the item to the branch's agent
Why is this row in this state?

facts.name: item.idle
facts.phrase: the time since the last sign of work
facts.source: projection (activity, else the facts' last change)

facts.name: agents.running
facts.phrase: the agents at work (running or starting)

facts.name: agents.idle
facts.phrase: the agents whose turn is over

facts.name: agent.reported
facts.phrase: the agent's report says where the ball is (it works on)

facts.name: pr.merged_into
facts.phrase: the branch the head is already in (empty: none)

facts.name: ci.first_failing
facts.source: Actions runs on the head, else PR checks

facts.name: ci.pr_red
facts.phrase: the PR's checks are red on its head
facts.source: PR checks, made precise by Actions

facts.name: items.count
facts.phrase: the work item's open inbox items

facts.name: items.blocks_agent
facts.phrase: an open inbox item blocks an agent

facts.name: tracker.linked
facts.source: tracker hub, else a feeder's facts

facts.name: tracker.status
facts.source: tracker adapter, else a feeder's facts

facts.name: tracker.qa
facts.phrase: the task's QA (unknown: no task, or nothing maps it)
facts.source: tracker adapter [<adapter>.qa] mapping, else a feeder's facts

facts.name: gesture.until
facts.phrase: your park's end (a time or an event)

facts.name: claim.active
facts.phrase: you passed it to the orchestrator

facts.name: holder
facts.phrase: who holds a routed item here (empty: nobody)

facts.name: delegation.agent
facts.phrase: the agent it was delegated to

facts.name: delegation.fact
facts.phrase: what the agent is fixing (empty: unsaid)

facts.name: report.needs_user
facts.phrase: the agent reported it needs you

functions.doc: with("CI red", detail): "CI red: <detail>", the prefix alone when the detail is empty or unknown; 5 words
functions.name: with

functions.doc: agents.detail_of("<status>"): the detail line of the first agent in that status
functions.name: agents.detail_of

kinds.says: An open PR red on its head with no agent at work on it.
kinds.title: CI failing

kinds.says: A fresh red Actions run on the head of a branch with no PR (I7).
kinds.title: CI failed
kinds.when: not pr.exists and ci.head == "red" and agents.running == 0

kinds.says: Only when nothing else runs there and there is no PR yet; never the orchestrator, nor an agent whose report says it works on.
kinds.title: Your turn
kinds.when: agent.status in ["completed", "waiting", "interrupted"] and agents.running == 0 and not pr.exists and not place.is_orchestrator and not agent.reported

kinds.says: A linked tracker task entered a status mapped with a level (its own).
kinds.title: Tracker

kinds.says: A brief: its level and blocks_agent are the item's own.
kinds.title: Decide

rules.says: Closing the PR stays the user's (never alone).

then.suggestion_expr: "close PR #" + pr.number + ": its head is in " + pr.merged_into

rules.says: The whole work item waits in Parked, with the ball it would have.
The work item's open inbox items, top first.
You passed it to the orchestrator.
The orchestrator holds a routed brief or question here.
Approved, CI green and mergeable: merging is yours, on the PR.
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and pr.review == "approved" and ci.state in ["green", "none"] and pr.mergeable == "mergeable"
pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and pr.review == "changes_requested"
pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and agents.running == 0 and pr.mergeable == "conflicting"
pr.state == "open" and not queue.enabled and agents.running == 0 and ci.state == "red"
not queue.enabled and agents.idle > 0 and agents.running == 0 and not pr.exists and report.ball == ""

rules.says: Never the agent's tool line ("Bash done"): that is noise on a row.
Ball agent: it works on in the background (its turn is over).

then.state_expr: report.ball == "agent" ? clip("agent " + report.agent + " · " + (report.note == "" ? "working" : report.note), 8) : clip(report.note == "" ? "reported: " + report.ball : report.note, 5)

rules.says: Without the queue: the level while the task's entered-status item is open.
rules.when: tracker.ball == "you" and known(tracker.level) and not queue.enabled

rules.says: Nobody was asked: that is the user's to do, not others' to wait on.
rules.when: pr.state == "open" and pr.review in ["review_required", "none"] and pr.review_requests == 0 and pr.reviews == 0

rules.says: An agent still on a dialog whose item was dismissed or parked.

then.state_expr: "waiting_for_approval" in agents.statuses ? "waits: approve" : "waiting_for_user" in agents.statuses ? "waits: answer" : "failed" in agents.statuses ? "waits: agent failed" : "possibly_hanged" in agents.statuses ? "waits: agent may hang" : "agent idle"

rules.says: Approved, green and mergeable with no Merge item: you dismissed or parked it, or one of your rules narrowed merge.
rules.when: queue.enabled and pr.state == "open" and pr.review == "approved" and ci.state in ["green", "none"] and pr.mergeable == "mergeable"
